entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is an application for anticipatory bail in C.R. No. 30 of
 2020 registered with Bhayandar Police Station, Thane for offences
 punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 & 328 r/w Section 34 of
 Indian Penal Code r/w Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 30(2)(a), 27,
3(1), (zz) (v), r/w Section 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act,
 2006.
2 .  Apparently the FIR was registered for offences which were  bailable in nature.
Subsequently Section 328 of Indian Penal Code  has been invoked which is non-bailable.

Learned counsel for the  applicant relies upon the Judgment of Division Bench of this Court Hashmukh Pralhad Kandiya Sathwara vs The State Of Maharashtra on 11 March, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73480940/
1  wherein it was held that, in such type of cases Section 328 cannot be  invoked.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid circumstance, interim protection can  be granted to the applicant.

ORDER i) In the event of arrest of applicant in C.R. No. 30 of 2020 registered with Bhayandar Police Station,
Thane the applicant be released on bail on furnishing P. R. Bond in the sum of Rs.25000/-, with one or more sureties in the like amount;

ii) The applicant shall attend Investigating Officer as and when called for.
iii) This interim protection granted till next date of hearing.
iv) Stand over to 27th March, 2020.
To be listed on Supplementary Board.

(PRAKASH D. NAIK, J.)
